subject: Updating the wiki page about contributing Stan functions

messages.author: 3f017a3b63263552
messages.subject: Updating the wiki page about contributing Stan functions
parts:
Hi,

I was trying to use the wiki page on contributing Stan functions (https://github.com/stan-dev/stan/wiki/Contributing-New-Functions-to-Stan) to debug an issue yesterday, but some of the information on the page is out of date or not there. For instance,

1) When I look in src from Stan, there isn't a src/test/gm/model_specs/compiled/ directory.

2) I can make test-headers, but when I try to make test-unit, I get the message that there's no rule to make it.

3) I didn't realize that for functions in src/test/test-models/good/function-signatures/math/functions/, you can make the models there by typing make src/test/test-models/good/function-signatures/math/functions/<function-name>.hpp-test. Also, on that note, where are the unit tests? The example given is for src/test/unit-agrad-rev/functions/log_test.cpp, but unit-grad-rev isn't a folder in src/test.

Could someone please look through and update the wiki page?

Thanks.

Best,
Rayleigh
